rationale.conceptual: The method involves several interacting formulas from field-induced nucleation, growth kinetics, and length statistics. Correctly deriving the nucleation barrier from the free energy maximum, converting between CGS and practical units (eV, Å), and numerically maximizing the length distribution require a solid understanding of the theory. This goes beyond a textbook operation but is not a novel algorithm; it is an established physics method with careful parameter handling.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is a single Python script that computes values and writes a JSON; no external tooling, data fetching, or multi-stage orchestration is needed.
